feedback: Elon's confession fits established access, the real active bottle, and the demonstrably impossible live-camera claim. The saved image explanation was already strongly implied by the technical report and rejected connection invoice, so it does not import a new technical solution. His taking poison at the preview and adding it later is newly admitted action, but no independent clue had uniquely assigned that action to him. Emotionally, his admission that others would still wait for promised work is a good, restrained end to his bluffing voice. Elle and Monet accepting their financial misconduct gives satisfying closure to their lies. I still feel the culprit selection needed one more differentiating clue: his camera lie could equally have concealed a failed sales demonstration.
new_decisive_facts: Elon admits personally taking the poison at the preview and putting it into Grant's private glass; the pre-vote evidence established opportunity but did not independently identify that action.
